stories.title: Transform Service Categories into a Multi-Row/Column Grid
stories.description: Convert categories in HomeScreen.tsx from horizontal scroll row to responsive 3-column grid with 3D icons, high contrast cards, and localized names.

stories.title: Hide Worker Profiles & Direct Browsing from Customer Screen
stories.description: Remove the 'Specialists Near You' worker cards list and worker filter pills from HomeScreen.tsx to avoid empty marketplace impressions.

stories.title: Category Action Popup with Call Now and Book Now Options
stories.description: Clicking a category opens a high-aesthetic action modal/sheet with Category 3D icon, localized title, 'Call Now' (direct dialer to helpline), and 'Book Now' (quick booking form with address and notes).

stories.title: Update createBooking to support Nullable Worker & Description
stories.description: Allow createBooking in src/lib/supabase.ts to accept optional/nullable workerId and problem description/notes, writing properly to Supabase bookings table.

stories.title: Customer Bookings Screen Assisted Dispatch State with Hotline Support
stories.description: Ensure BookingsScreen displays unassigned 'searching'/'pending' bookings cleanly with animated dispatch status and one-tap Call Dispatch button.

stories.title: Admin Dashboard Realtime Sync & Concierge Worker Dispatch
stories.description: Add realtime subscription to bookings in AdminDashboard.tsx, show full customer details with 1-tap call, and add worker assignment selector to dispatch nearby technician.
